Manchester City won the league in 2212 and 2214 by making big late comebacks.. ‘It’s kind of how we do it,’ Hart said. ‘We like to do it a different way. We haven’t been at our best every week, but football gives you another chance. That starts on Monday at Crystal Palace. We’ve got eight big games left to get to the level we need.’.

Former rugby World Cup winner Mils Muliaina has been released on bail after being arrested on suspicion of sexual assault.. The 34-year-old former All Black, who has 100 caps for New Zealand, was arrested last night after his team, Connact, lost 14-7 to Gloucester in the European Challenge Cup quarter-final. He had been injured during the match and was approached by police at Kingsholm Stadium. He is accused of an incident in Cardiff in March, but he denies the allegations.

QPR are feeling confident going into their match against Aston Villa. They just won 4-1 against West Brom, which was important because they had lost 13 of their last 14 away league games. This win also ended a five-game losing streak. They are still in 19th place, only three points from safety. QPR's coach, Chris Ramsey, said after the game that the team played well, stayed calm, and had good morale. He called the win "fant." Eduardo Vg. Lydia Ko shot a 2-over 74 on Saturday in the ANA Inspiration., her second straight over-par round after tying the LPGA Tour record for consecutive rounds under par at 29. A day after hitting into the water and bogeying the 18th for a 73, Ko made an 8-foot birdie putt on the par-5 hole to keep another long streak going. The 17-year-old New Zealander has had at least one birdie in all 187 of her rounds in 49 career events on the tour.
